text:
helen: Following up from today's all-hands Q&A re: reliability incident — dropping RCA + short owner list so leadership items and roadmap asks are captured.

helen: RCA link: https://internal.redwood.ai/rca/INC-2026-321 (root cause: stale route preference + race in spillover path). Doc includes timeline, mitigations, and artifacts.

martin: thanks. quick clarity: will this require changes to the universal routing policy in the roadmap or is it a contained fix?

yusuf: it's two parts: (1) a code patch to the route-applier (contained), (2) a roadmap change to add a config-validation step before rollout (product/devex).

clare: I'll take the product side to propose wording for the roadmap item and prioritize with the next sprint. ETA: next planning meeting.

ops-bot: canary-deploy: route-applier-canary -> success. (automated)

bri: comms ask: leadership wants one-line copy for the customer status page post-rollout. Should we say "mitigated" only after global rollout?

helen: yes — "Mitigation applied; validation ongoing; full rollouts scheduled" unless all regions report green. Keep it short.

eva: I'll own the global rollout schedule and coordinate region owners. ETA: draft schedule by EOD tomorrow.

sylvia: i'll add a telemetry alert for spillover signals and a dashboard tile for leadership to monitor.

martin: accepted: roadmap entry draft -> clare (due: 2026-04-12).
yusuf: accepted: route-applier PR + tests -> yusuf (due: 2026-04-06).
eva: accepted: rollout schedule + coordinate regions -> eva (due: 2026-04-02).
sylvia: accepted: telemetry alert & dashboard -> sylvia (due: 2026-04-03).

helen: ACTIONS (mirrored to tracker):
- yusuf: code patch for route-applier + unit/integration tests
- clara (clare): draft roadmap/workflow change to require config-validation before rollout
- eva: global rollout schedule & region coordination
- sylvia: telemetry alert + leadership dashboard tile
- bri: draft status page blurb and hold until global signoff

helen: one leadership ask: add a short note in product roadmap about "release-check: routing validation" so PMs know to include it in deployment gates. @clare please link in the roadmap doc.

clare: noted, will add and ping product-ops.

yusuf: tiny blocker: need permissions to push to the infra-test repo for the integration tests. @ops-bot can you open the grant?

ops-bot: permission-request submitted for yusuf -> infra-test write access (expected approval: ~15m).

bri: will prepare the status blurb template and share in this thread for review before posting.

sylvia: adding alert that fires if spillrate > 0.3% for 10m and surface to leadership channel.

helen: thanks all. please react when you pick up your item so I can mark progress in the tracker. we'll close loops in the next ops sync. :white_check_mark:
